(async()=>{const m=await import('/js/flight/aircraft.js'); const out={}; for (const t of [0,5,10,20,35,50,70,100,130]) { const s=m.sampleReal(t,{pos:new __fl.THREE.Vector3()}); out[t]={alt:Math.round(s.alt), hdg:Math.round(s.hdg)}; for (const k of ['LGA13','LGA4','TEB1']) { const r=m.reach(s.pos,s.hdg,s.alt,m.AIRPORTS[k].p); out[t][k]=Math.round(r.margin)+'/'+Math.round(r.dist)+'/t'+Math.round(r.turn); } } return JSON.stringify(out)})()
